=You are an expert AI researcher. Summarize the provided academic paper into a clear, punchy, 2-3 sentence TL;DR for a podcast show notes entry.

Focus on:
1. What core problem or gap the paper addresses.
2. The primary method, framework, or technique introduced.
3. The key finding or takeaway.

Requirements:
- Keep it under 60 words total.
- Write in plain text without quotes, markdown headers, or bullet points.
- Output ONLY the TL;DR text directly. Do not include any introductory phrase like "Here is the TL;DR:".

Paper Title: {{ $('Paper').item.json.title }}
Full Text:
{{ $('Paper').item.json.fullText }}

=You are an expert AI podcast host delivering an in-depth solo research briefing. You will be provided with the full text of an academic paper. Write a comprehensive, highly engaging, single-speaker podcast script that is strictly between 680 and 720 words (targeting a 5-minute listening duration).

Structure the monologue naturally:
1. The Hook & Context (1 min): Why this problem matters and what gap the paper addresses.
2. Core Methodology (2 mins): Break down the technical approach, architecture, or theoretical framework clearly.
3. Results & Implications (2 mins): Discuss key findings, limitations, and how this impacts future developments.

Do not include sound effects, background music cues, or speaker labels. Output only the spoken monologue text.

PREPARE FOR AUDIO READABILITY:
Rewrite all mathematical expressions, citations, and academic abbreviations into natural, spoken English prose:
- Numbers & Sections: "Theorem 2.3" -> "Theorem two point three", "Section 4.1" -> "Section four point one"
- Equations & Citations: "Eq. (5)" -> "Equation five", "Ref. [12]" -> "reference twelve"
- Math Notation: "x^2" -> "x squared", "f(x)" -> "f of x", "R^n" -> "R n", "A \in B" -> "A in B"
- Greek Letters & Symbols: "rho_0" -> "rho zero", "d/dt" -> "the time derivative of"
- Common Shorthand: "e.g." -> "for example", "i.e." -> "that is", "w.r.t." -> "with respect to", "WLOG" -> "without loss of generality"
- Remove all raw LaTeX delimiters ($...$, \[...\], \begin{equation}...) entirely.

Paper Title: {{ $('Paper').item.json.title }}
Full Text:
{{ $('Paper').item.json.fullText }}

=You are an expert podcast host. Write an in-depth solo academic lecture ('Breakdown') on the attached paper. 
Target word count: strictly between 2,100 and 2,300 words (15 minutes of audio).

Break down the monologue into these 5 clear chapters:
1. Technical Problem & Motivation (400 words)
2. Theoretical Framework & Mathematical Underpinnings (600 words)
3. Architecture & Physical/Algorithmic Implementation (600 words)
4. Empirical Results, Baselines, and Benchmark Comparison (400 words)
5. Critical Assessment, Limitations, and Future Outlook (200 words)

Write in full spoken prose without markdown formatting or headers.

PREPARE FOR AUDIO READABILITY:
Rewrite all mathematical expressions, citations, and academic abbreviations into natural, spoken English prose:
- Numbers & Sections: "Theorem 2.3" -> "Theorem two point three", "Section 4.1" -> "Section four point one"
- Equations & Citations: "Eq. (5)" -> "Equation five", "Ref. [12]" -> "reference twelve"
- Math Notation: "x^2" -> "x squared", "f(x)" -> "f of x", "R^n" -> "R n", "A \in B" -> "A in B"
- Greek Letters & Symbols: "rho_0" -> "rho zero", "d/dt" -> "the time derivative of"
- Common Shorthand: "e.g." -> "for example", "i.e." -> "that is", "w.r.t." -> "with respect to", "WLOG" -> "without loss of generality"
- Remove all raw LaTeX delimiters ($...$, \[...\], \begin{equation}...) entirely.

Paper Title: {{ $('Paper').item.json.title }}
Full Text:
{{ $('Paper').item.json.fullText }}

=You are an expert researcher and the solo host of an elite technical audio-essay series.
Your goal is to design a detailed 5-chapter outline for a 45-minute, single-speaker deep dive on the provided paper.

Paper Title: {{ $('Paper').item.json.title }}
Full Text:
{{ $('Paper').item.json.fullText }}

Target Total Duration: 45 minutes (~6,000 total words).

The structure must sustain listener engagement for a long solo runtime. Each chapter must build logically on the last. 
Output a valid JSON array of 5 distinct chapter objects. Do NOT wrap in markdown fences.
Strict JSON format:
[
  {
    "chapter_num": 1,
    "title": "The Core Paradigm Shift & Motivation",
    "target_words": 1200,
    "key_topics": ["Historical context", "The primary failure of existing methods", "The paper's core thesis"],
    "narrative_goal": "Hook the listener and establish why this problem matters."
  },
  {
    "chapter_num": 2,
    "title": "Theoretical Framework & Mathematical Formulation",
    "target_words": 1400,
    "key_topics": ["Formal definitions", "Key equations explained verbally", "Theoretical guarantees"],
    "narrative_goal": "Unpack the math clearly using analogies."
  },
  {
    "chapter_num": 3,
    "title": "System Architecture & Implementation",
    "target_words": 1300,
    "key_topics": ["System design", "Novel components", "Experimental setup"],
    "narrative_goal": "Explain how it is actually built and run."
  },
  {
    "chapter_num": 4,
    "title": "Empirical Results, Baselines & Benchmarks",
    "target_words": 1200,
    "key_topics": ["Ablation studies", "Benchmark performance", "Surprising failures"],
    "narrative_goal": "Analyze the data objectively."
  },
  {
    "chapter_num": 5,
    "title": "Critique, Future Directions & Broader Impact",
    "target_words": 900,
    "key_topics": ["Unaddressed limitations", "Open research questions", "Practical implications"],
    "narrative_goal": "Deliver a strong, critical conclusion."
  }
]
